cues.text: Thank you for joining me for this short
video that will walk you through
activating an MVS calibrator plate.
Let's go ahead and get started. When you
first receive your new MVS system and
you want to use your MVS calibrator
plate or if your calibrator plate has
been reertified and has been returned to
you or if you have a new installation of
our Telware on a new computer with a new
database, your MVS calibrator plate will
need to be activated. Within the silver
carry case of your NVS calibrator plate,
there should be located an activation
code card. To activate your calibrator
plate, click on the scan barcode
shortcut that's located on the home
screen and scan the barcode of your
calibrator plate. Next, click on the
activate MVS calibrator plate box and
scan the activation code card that came
with your plate. You'll then see a
message indicating that your calibrator
plate has been successfully activated.
Congratulations.
Okay, that concludes our brief tutorial.
Do you have additional questions? Please
contact us at 1800225434
option3 or at supportic
companies.com.
Thank you.
